Identity: the saved sample ( line 366) has p.23 fn.4 'se entendera por balengue a los individuos de este colectivo y molengue [mölengue], su lengua vernacula'; author born in Sipolo, distrito de Mbini = coastal Rio Muni = bxc. Quote check against : p.302 '.. vocal recibe un tono determinado (en el caso del mölengue, alto y bajo), y los tonos tienen valor fonológico,…
new_statements.relation_note: Two level tones (H, L) with phonological value; tone diacritics; aspirated vowels ä ë ö ü; noun classes 1-20 with concords and demonstratives. No stress statement seen.
new_statements.rule_in_words: Mölengue (Balengue) is described as a tone language with two tones, high and low, which are phonologically distinctive; the proposed orthography marks tone with diacritics (acute/grave for high, diaeresis or no mark for low). Nothing seen about word stress; 'acentos gráficos' refers to written diacritics, not stress.
new_statements.secondary_stress: not mentioned in the text seen
new_statements.exceptions: none in the snippets; vowel doubling (e.g. mwaána) noted as a related orthographic issue
new_statements.identity_note: Explicitly about the Balengue of the Mbini/Muni coast of Equatorial Guinea and their language: p.23 fn.4 'Mölengue es la denominación propia de los mismos balengues.. se entenderá por balengue a los individuos de este colectivo y mölengue, su lengua vernácula'; author born in Sipolo (distrito de Mbini), of Balengue descent. = ISO bxc / mole1238; not the Cameroon village 'Balengue' nor CAR 'Molengue'.
